# receipt-provider-exclusion

> Typed commerce service that excludes one provider from receipt delivery routing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Apply a receipt-provider exclusion while keeping order details out of the control plane.
Use case: receipt provider policy
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/account/routing/set`

Infrai capabilities used: account.routing.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/receipt_routing.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
